external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person receiving an invoice email and accessing its payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used to manage invoices, customers, payout bank details, payment pages, PDF requests, and customer sessions.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: An administrative console from which support agents can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details, with a company ID column on every table.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Nobody recorded how the billing app and the renderer reach the database, or how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket where the PDF renderer writes PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: Nobody recorded how the billing app and the renderer reach the bucket, or how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Billing-app requests and responses

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Request to view an invoice payment page

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number

data_flows.name: manage tenant data
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies. Nobody recorded how the billing app reaches the database.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice updates

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the billing app reaches the queue.
data_flows.data_description: Render job containing a company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the queue.
data_flows.data_description: Render job containing a company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the database.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using a company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries. Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the bucket.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The billing app uses one service credential for all companies. Nobody recorded how the billing app reaches the bucket.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.authentication: own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Administrative console sign-in

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.data_description: Session in the billing app as a customer user

data_flows.name: record agent actions
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Records of actions attributed to the customer user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform hosting the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it holds customer information, invoices, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes invoice PDFs to the bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console has internal exposure because it is reachable only from the support office network.
assumptions.basis: The source states: "The admin console is reachable only from there," referring to the support office network.
